# Closest-result matrix

| Work | Object | Main conclusion | Relation to Paper 02 | Difference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Balaban 1984 | lattice gauge Gaussian theory and propagators | RG propagator architecture | closest linear/RG baseline | no matching executable side-two certificate |
| Balaban 1987 | 4D pure gauge, small-field approximation | localized effective actions and coupling recursion | much stronger multiscale objective | Paper 02 is one exact local cylinder with modern exact artifacts |
| Balaban 1988 | fluctuation integral | cluster expansion and inductive control | true repeated-action mechanism | Paper 02 does not prove cluster locality or iteration |
| Balaban 1989 | large-field operation | completes a stated UV stability argument | closest complement-control baseline | the interacting complement is explicitly open here |
| Menotti--Onofri 1981 | heat-kernel lattice action | regulator construction and properties | same plaquette interaction family | Paper 02 supplies local derivative and marginal bounds |
| Ligterink--Walet--Bishop 2000 | Hamiltonian lattice gauge theory | maximal-tree variables and constraints | same gauge-coordinate idea | different Hamiltonian aim; no present block theorem |
| Brascamp--Lieb 1976 | log-concave measures | covariance/marginal inequalities | imported analytic mechanism | not gauge-specific |
| Paper 02 | fixed \(2^4\) SU(2) heat-kernel block | exact quotient, rational floor, nonlinear action norm, one local marginal | integrated certificate | no large-field, iteration, continuum, or mass gap |

Novelty classification:

- theorem novelty: conservative, limited to the exact integrated finite-block statement;
- proof-method novelty: not claimed;
- explicit-constant/certification novelty: principal contribution;
- application novelty: explicit four-dimensional SU(2) quotient--fiber instance;
- conceptual novelty: proof-bearing interface across quotient, chart, conditioning, and marginalization.
